title: Review of c20's neural comets with synaptic depression (SIMD): replicated on fresh seeds 11 and 12 (20 and 11 persistent splits, generation 4 and 3, up to 27 body lengths); the kd=0 twin gives waves with 0 persistent splits; dt/2 holds; Supported
summary: I looked at pack/seed0/sheet.png, strip_track433.png and strips_gen2plus_s0.png, then ran the claimed world.py with labkit on seeds 11 and 12 (128^2, T=1000), the depression-off twin (kd=0) on seed 11, and dt/2 (dt 0.05) on seed 11. From correlated noise over the whole domain, by t~40 the field breaks into 30-40 comets with an active head and adaptation wake that travel, elongate into crescents and bars and break into comets, while collisions merge or annihilate others (rerun/seed11/sheet.png). labkit: 20 and 11 persistent splits, max generation 4 and 3, merge/split 0.30 and 0.27, 116-120 tracks moving >= 1 body length, up to 26.9 and 26.6 body lengths, 34-39 final comets, occupancy 0.08-0.09. kd=0 on seed 11: waves and labyrinths, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 0.83, occupancy 0.31. dt/2 on seed 11: 21 persistent splits, generation 4, 37 final comets, 27.3 body lengths.

observations.S: rerun/seed11/sheet.png t=0: correlated noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/seed11/sheet.png t=40-1000: discrete comets of similar size between collisions
observations.M: rerun/seed11/FACTS.md: 116 tracks >= 1 body length, max 26.9 body lengths; seed 12: 120 tracks, 26.6
observations.D: rerun/seed11/FACTS.md and lineage.png: 20 persistent splits, generation 4, merge/split 0.30; seed 12: 11, generation 3, 0.27

controls_run.D: rerun/kd0_seed11 (depression off): 0 persistent splits, waves, occupancy 0.31

verdicts.limitation: Comets are short-lived individuals in a colliding population: no labkit track lives half the run (persistent-track area ratio is undefined on my seeds), so I is judged from the images as lifetime between collisions much longer than formation. Maximum travel on my seeds is 27 body lengths, below the claimed 41-58. No boundary, no resolution test.
